brief: The canvas displays a slow, continuous tide of translucent, overlapping circles that appear to rise from the bottom of a dark background. These large, softly flowing shapes are intertwined with numerous small, visible pointillist stars. The scene features constant, subtle movement as the circles drift and flow upward. The viewer can interact with the stream by clicking anywhere on the canvas, which triggers a ripple effect that momentarily pushes the surrounding circles apart before they resume their slow, continuous movement.

statement: This sketch creates an immersive underwater scene with a slow, flowing tide of translucent blue-gray circles that rise from the bottom of the dark canvas. The circles drift upward at different speeds and sizes, creating a sense of depth and continuous motion. Thousands of tiny pointillist stars dot the background, providing a celestial contrast to the organic flow of the circles. The viewer can interact with this flowing tide by clicking anywhere on the canvas, which triggers a ripple effect that pushes nearby circles apart before they resume their gentle ascent. The subtle color variations and translucent layers create a dreamlike quality reminiscent of oceanic movement and cosmic space simultaneously.
